# sigma_connection_path (Data Source)

Look up a connection path UUID by its (connection_id, path) tuple. Use the result for `sigma_connection_path_grant.connection_path_id`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Resolve a slash-delimited warehouse path into the path UUID needed by
# sigma_connection_path_grant.
data "sigma_connection_path" "customers_table" {
  connection_id = sigma_connection.snowflake.id
  path          = "ANALYTICS/PUBLIC/CUSTOMERS"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `connection_id` (String)
- `path` (String) The path within the connection, e.g. `database.schema` or `database.schema.table`.

### Read-Only

- `connection_path_id` (String)
